in_sanskrit.name: Devshanthan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Gods, Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Devshanthan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Devshanthan is a name derived from two Sanskrit words: Deva (God) and Ishan (Lord, Ruler). The name Devshanthan signifies the God of Gods, the supreme ruler, the Lord of the Universe, and the master of all beings.
